# Pushinn

> Pushinn is a platform for street skateboarders and BMX riders. It is built around Game of S.K.A.T.E. battles, a live skate spot map, and the Skaters' Union community. It is made by Pushinn Labs LTD, a company registered in England and Wales (company number 17046072).

## Key pages
- [Home](https://pushinn.app/): what Pushinn is
- [What we're building](https://pushinn.app/building): the mission and roadmap
- [Dev log](https://pushinn.app/devlog): what has been built and when
- [The Skaters' Union](https://pushinn.app/union): the community page (bugs, ideas, votes)
- [Support](https://pushinn.app/support): help and contact
- [Safety](https://pushinn.app/safety): safety information
